text: hey so, i have been under the impression that the current @cart/editor/ has all of its models now saved on disk and not in a database. but when i tree the directory, i dont see pretty much any of the models that i see in the content browser of the app, and so im wondering what is the deal? where are they located if they arnt in here or am i missing them ?
resolution: Answered where content-browser models live: only ~20 packages are on-disk under cart/editor/data/models/{props,build,roundtrip}; the rest of what the browser shows still comes from hmsc-int era snapshot stores (model.snapshot.json 7MB, cooked-asset.snapshot.json 26MB, importedProps.data.json, loose files under cart/hmsc-int/) merged in hmscAssetCatalog.ts loadHmscEditorCatalog. The on-disk package system exists and wins name collisions, but the legacy catalog was never migrated into it — no code change, investigation only.
